edges.reason: nTokens parameter controls the mint loop and amount accounting in mint().
mint() is gated by the ifSaleStarted modifier reading saleStarted.
maxSupply bounds the supply check in mint().
price is multiplied by nTokens to validate msg.value in mint().
reserved is subtracted from maxSupply in the supply bound check.
msg.sender is passed as the token recipient, becoming the callback target of _safeMint.
mint() calls _safeMint which performs an external onERC721Received callback to msg.sender.
nTokens * price computation inside mint() is user-influenced arithmetic.
supply local is derived from totalSupply() and used to allocate token IDs.
qty parameter drives allowance checks, payment and mint loop in earlyMint().
earlyMint() requires preSaleStarted to be true.
earlyMint() requires saleStarted to be false.
presalePermission mapping gates and is decremented by earlyMint().
price multiplied by qty validates msg.value in earlyMint().
msg.sender is used both for permission lookup and as _safeMint recipient in earlyMint().
earlyMint() calls _safeMint, triggering an external onERC721Received callback to the caller.
price * qty arithmetic in earlyMint() uses caller-supplied quantity.
wallets array drives the permission grant loop in whitelist().
whitelist() writes presalePermission entries.
whitelist() is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is compared against owner() inside onlyOwner for whitelist().
changePreSaleStartedVariable() toggles preSaleStarted.
startingIndex is read to decide whether to initialize it.
changePreSaleStartedVariable() is restricted by onlyOwner.
changePreSaleStartedVariable() conditionally calls setStartingIndex().
changeSaleStartedVariable() toggles saleStarted.
changeSaleStartedVariable() is restricted by onlyOwner.
_URI argument is written into baseURI by setBaseURI().
setBaseURI() mutates the baseURI state variable.
setBaseURI() is restricted by onlyOwner.
newPrice argument is written into price by setPrice().
setPrice() mutates the price state variable.
setPrice() is restricted by onlyOwner.
newMaxSupply argument is written into maxSupply by setMaxSupply().
setMaxSupply() mutates the maxSupply state variable.
setMaxSupply() is restricted by onlyOwner.
provenanceHash argument is written into KoT_Provenance.
setProvenanceHash() is restricted by onlyOwner.
owner argument selects which balance/enumeration data walletOfOwner() reads.
number argument bounds how many reserved tokens claimReserved() mints.
_receiver argument is the mint destination in claimReserved().
reserved is decremented by number in claimReserved().
claimReserved() is restricted by onlyOwner.
claimReserved() calls _safeMint on an owner-chosen receiver, triggering an external callback.
setStartingIndex() writes and also checks startingIndex for re-initialization.
maxSupply is used as modulus for the derived startingIndex.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak-based pseudo-random shift in setStartingIndex().
setStartingIndex() is restricted by onlyOwner.
setStartingIndex() derives indices from blockhash/difficulty/timestamp, a predictable randomness source.
generateNewClub() writes indexBackground.
generateNewClub() writes indexSkintone.
generateNewClub() writes indexToy.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak-based pseudo-random shifts in generateNewClub().
generateNewClub() is restricted by onlyOwner.
generateNewClub() derives trait indices from blockhash/difficulty/timestamp, a predictable randomness source.
withdraw() reads the _owner state variable through owner() to pick the recipient.
withdraw() is restricted by onlyOwner.
msg.sender is compared to owner() by onlyOwner before withdrawal.
balance local captures address(this).balance used for the payout in withdraw().
withdraw() forwards the entire balance to the owner address using send.
constructor initializes saleStarted to false.
constructor initializes preSaleStarted to false.
from parameter flows into the transfer bookkeeping hook.
to parameter flows into the transfer bookkeeping hook.
tokenId parameter flows into the transfer bookkeeping hook.

normalization_plan.reason: nTokens is a parameter only used inside mint() to bound the loop and validate payment.
qty is a parameter only used inside earlyMint() for allowance, payment and loop control.
wallets is a parameter only used inside whitelist() to populate presalePermission.
newPrice is a parameter only used to assign the price state variable in setPrice().
newMaxSupply is a parameter only used to assign maxSupply in setMaxSupply().
_URI is a parameter only used to assign baseURI in setBaseURI().
provenanceHash is a parameter only used to assign KoT_Provenance in setProvenanceHash().
owner_param is a parameter only used inside the walletOfOwner() view enumeration.
number is a parameter only used inside claimReserved() to bound and decrement reserved.
_receiver is a parameter only used as the _safeMint destination in claimReserved().
from is a parameter only consumed by the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
to is a parameter only consumed by the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
tokenId is a parameter only consumed by the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
supply is a local variable computed and consumed inside mint() for token ID allocation.
balance is a local variable computed and consumed inside withdraw() for the payout amount.
